incident.title: Possible Ransomware Activity
incident.description:
RDRS detected suspicious ransomware-like file activity.

Threat score: 95
Severity: CRITICAL
Suspect process: python.exe

Reasons:
- High file modification rate
- Multiple extension changes
- High file entropy

Affected files:
- data/sandbox/test1.txt
- data/sandbox/test2.txt

recommendations: Isolate the suspected endpoint from the network.
Review the suspect process and its parent process.
Review recent file modification and rename activity.
Check authentication and system logs for related activity.
Verify backups before restoring affected files.
Keep RDRS monitoring enabled until the incident is resolved.
